meta.title: OpenLawn routing + scheduling Ralph loop
meta.scope: Make daily route generation and schedule UI work with real crews/customers, proven on screen.

tasks.title: Seeded crews/customers produce a route

At least one active customer matches that crew's service type today

tasks.title: Manager sees today's routed stops

Assigned stops for today lists routed customers

tasks.title: Employee sees the crew route
acceptance: employee@ralph.test lands on a route/stops experience (not empty manager chrome)
Assigned customers or stop list includes seeded yards
